versions.changelog: Candidate L: five-stage Inspect, Specify, Build, Validate, Deliver workflow; reliability and editing API fixes.

Reliable 3D comparison: completed builds stay recoverable, exact diffing is bounded and observable, difficult CAD gets a labeled approximate fallback, and the default agent interface is build123d-first.
Fully featured parts: named, colored, grouped part review handoffs.

Specs and measurement polish: aligned inspect/measure schema docs, trimmed verbose feature output, improved high-risk edit guidance, fixed NURBS STEP bbox measurement noise, and added python -m agentcad support.
Refresh launch docs and skill text for build123d default runtime; CadQuery remains supported.
Fix daemon-routed failures returning empty output; failures now surface structured JSON.
Windows-safe daemon fallback and MCP traceback visibility

- Version updated to 0.2.0.
- Documentation refreshed in SKILL.md.
- No new features or command changes; content and workflow remain the same.
Visual feedback by default: 4-view preview, auto-diff, unified viewer

agentcad v0.1.5 — CAD tool for AI agents

- CLI tool for executing CadQuery scripts, producing STEP files, PNG renders, mesh exports (STL/GLB/OBJ), and geometric metrics.
- Designed for 3D modeling tasks requested by users; all core CadQuery and helper functions are pre-injected.
- Requires Python 3.10-3.12 and agentcad installed.
- Core workflow: script writing, dry-run for validation, real run for output, inspection, and version comparison.
- Offers debugging guidance and script-writing rules for reliability and flexibility.
- Includes a comprehensive set of commands for project setup, execution, rendering, exporting, inspection, and documentation access.
